values.note: Erie County Parks' own reservation system (online) or (716) 858-8355. 'Camping reservations for the following season are available one year from the date of interest.' All reservations are final and non-refundable. Arrival 3 pm, departure 11 am. Maximum 8 people, and 1 camper/RV plus 1 tent, per site.

booking.source: https://www3.erie.gov/parks/sprague-brook ('Camping - Call (716) 858-8355'; 'There is a 2-night minimum stay on the weekend'; 'Arrival time is 3PM, Departure time is 11AM'; SITE CAPACITY) + https://www3.erie.gov/parks/reservations ('Click to Make a Camping, Building or Shelter Reservation!' -> parks.go2gov.net; 'Camping reservations for the following season are available one year from the date of interest'; 'All reservations made are final, non-refundable'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Electric sites 1-30 May 1-Oct 31; electric sites 31-72 May 15-Columbus Day; non-electric sites Memorial Day weekend-Columbus Day weekend.

season.source: https://www3.erie.gov/parks/sprague-brook ('Electric campsites 1-30 are available May 1 - October 31; sites 31-72 are available May 15- Columbus Day. Non-electric sites are available Memorial Day Weekend through Columbus Day Weekend.'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www3.erie.gov/parks/sites/www3.erie.gov.parks/files/2024-09/electric-campsite-reference-data.pdf ('Sprague Brook Park - Electric Campsite Site Information', AMP column), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 72 electric sites (1-72) plus non-electric sites; the county's reservation rules number campsites to 123. Electric sites are 20-50 ft deep, most 25-50 ft.

note: Erie County park (Glenwood), the county's only camping park. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on Erie County's page (changed 2026-04-20): $23 non-electric / $30 electric (fees left as recorded 2026-10-10), online reservations on the county's go2gov system or by phone. Added 1-year window, 2-night weekend minimum, season May 1-Oct 31 by site group, 50 A max (61 x 30 A, 11 x 50 A). Cleared the derived site count 72: that is the number of electric sites alone, and campsites are numbered to 123 (exact total not stated). Note trimmed of sites, dump, booking, price and season text. Dump station, water and sewer not stated on the county pages.
